title: Deposit Invoice at Signature — Professional Services Projects
content:
On signature of a Professional Services Projects statement of work the deposit is invoiced. On signature of a time-and-materials statement of work, and only of one, the deposit is invoiced as the time-and-materials deposit; the deposit of a fixed-fee statement of work remains the class deposit percentage of the original contract value, rounded half up to the cent.

## When the deposit is fixed

The deposit of a time-and-materials statement of work is fixed only after the engagement record carries the client's signature date and the rate discount locked at signature.

Put the other way round: while the engagement record does not yet show both a signature date and the rate discount locked at signature, the deposit of a time-and-materials statement of work is not yet fixed.

| Statement of work | Deposit invoiced on signature |
|---|---|
| fixed fee | the class deposit percentage of the original contract value, rounded half up to the cent |
| time and materials | the time-and-materials deposit, fixed once the engagement record carries the signature date and the rate discount locked at signature |

## Posting tool: `post_deposit_invoice_06d795b1`

**Capability.** Posts the deposit invoice of a signed statement of work to the engagement's billing. A new deposit charge is added to the engagement's billing with a newly assigned invoice number, today's date as its posting date and the current month as its billing month; the client can then see the deposit invoice and its amount on the engagement's billing.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_deposit_invoice_06d795b1` (through `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `project_engagement_id` | the reference number of the project engagement the deposit belongs to, as returned by the project engagement lookup | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the deposit amount in US dollars | a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation string giving the new billing entry reference, the invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits), the engagement reference number, the deposit amount in US dollars with two decimal places and the posting date in year-month-day form; that string indicates the deposit invoice was posted.
